content.short: CoinEasy is an all-in-one Web3 mobile app guide to the crypto world.
content.description: CoinEasy delivers a straightforward Web3 onboarding experience by pairing a clean, user-friendly interface with social ID login and automatically creating and encrypting a Web3 wallet for each user. This hands-off wallet setup reduces friction for new entrants and smooths the transition from Web2 to Web3, enabling users to explore decentralized concepts with confidence. In addition, CoinEasy provides a dedicated educational space designed to help users expand their blockchain knowledge and stay curious about emerging technologies.
